comparison.objective: Insert five coins through a piggy-bank slot; candidate selectively screens ceramic media while retaining washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-object pickup, reorientation, and one-at-a-time slot insertion versus bulk pouring and orientation-dependent many-body passage through apertures.
comparison.success_condition: All five coins wholly inside without tipping the bank versus recovery-mass threshold, complete washer retention, immutable spill controls, and released screen dwell.
comparison.reason: Both involve objects passing openings, but insertion alignment of individual coins does not test selective granular separation or bridge clearing.
